walkthrough:
Calculate the inner function value at $x = 5$:
$$f(5) = \frac{5 + 3}{5 - 1} = \frac{8}{4} = 2$$

Apply the function $f$ to the intermediate result:
$$ff(5) = f(2) = \frac{2 + 3}{2 - 1} = \frac{5}{1} = 5$$

hints: Collect all $x$ terms on one side and make $x$ the subject.
walkthrough:
Set $y = \frac{x + 3}{x - 1}$ and clear the denominator:
$$y(x - 1) = x + 3 \implies yx - y = x + 3$$

Rearrange all terms containing $x$ to one side:
$$yx - x = y + 3 \implies x(y - 1) = y + 3$$

Divide by $(y - 1)$ and state the inverse function in terms of $x$:
$$x = \frac{y + 3}{y - 1} \implies f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + 3}{x - 1}$$
